newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil eases on profit taking into the close.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil eases on profit taking into the close.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended near session lows on profit taking and book squaring ahead of the U.S. Labor Day holiday weekend, traders said.
"Technicals are still showing the market overbought and NYMEX heat weakened over the afternoon so people took profits and squared out ahead of the weekend," a broker said.
After charging to 4-1/2 month highs on Thursday, selling into the close pegged September gas oil futures back to last trade at $196.75 a tonne, unchanged from Thursday's settlement.
Trade was cautious due to uncertainty as to how the U.S. products would react with September contracts expiring today.
Some traders expect gas oil futures could further extend gains next week despite the market's overbought state.
"There are market rumours that because of the change in spec to 0.05 diesel in October, (a trading company) may try and squeeze the 0.2 market," a broker said.
Oct Brent crude futures were hovering around support at $20.70 a barrel at the close of gas oil after rallying to a new contract high of $21 a barrel at this morning's opening.
Its $21 high was the strongest for a spot contract since April 15 but floor brokers were sceptical since the last five to 10 cents of this morning's rally was on very thin volume.
